findings.title: IAM policy grants wildcard permissions
findings.message: Allows every action on every resource
findings.remediation: List the specific actions and resources the workload needs (least privilege).

findings.title: S3 bucket is publicly accessible
findings.message: Assets uses the PublicRead access control
findings.remediation: Use a private ACL, enable all four settings of the public access block, and grant access with specific principals or CloudFront origin access control.

findings.title: Security group open to the internet
findings.message: WebGroup allows the internet to reach port 22
findings.remediation: Restrict the source to your own CIDR range or a security group, and use SSM Session Manager or a VPN instead of public SSH.

findings.title: Database reachable from the internet
findings.remediation: Set publicly_accessible = false and reach the database through a private subnet, a VPN or a bastion host.

findings.title: Storage encryption at rest not enabled
findings.message: Database does not set StorageEncrypted to true
findings.remediation: Set storage_encrypted = true (RDS) or encrypted = true (EBS), ideally with a KMS key.
